scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['node_modules', 'frontend/node_modules', 'backend/node_modules'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, {recursive: true, force: true}))"
scripts.start:win: powershell -Command "Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-Command', 'cd backend; node simple-server.js' -WindowStyle Minimized; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-Command', 'cd frontend; npm start' -WindowStyle Minimized"
